values.meaning: The event belongs to the exchange generation the slot holds and, where the state waits for an operation, to that operation.
The event belongs to an older operation or exchange generation, or the slot holds no exchange it could belong to.
The effect box and the result reserve can hold what the transition publishes.
At least one needed slot is missing.
The canonical bytes equal those stored for the OperationId.
The packet arrives on a connection established after the one that carried the PUBLISH of the exchange.
The packet arrives on the connection that already carried a PUBLISH of the exchange, or no earlier PUBLISH of the exchange exists.

event_classes.name: PublishQos2
event_classes.meaning: A validated QoS 2 PUBLISH carrying the Packet Identifier of the slot.

event_classes.name: Pubrel
event_classes.meaning: A validated PUBREL carrying the Packet Identifier of the slot.

event_classes.name: AdmissionResult
event_classes.meaning: A StoreResult for an AdmitPublication of this session.

event_classes.name: ReleaseResult
event_classes.meaning: A StoreResult for a ReleaseInbound of this session.

event_classes.name: Submit
event_classes.meaning: The owner hands the frozen command to its effect box.

event_classes.name: StoreResult
event_classes.meaning: A result is delivered for this OperationId.

event_classes.name: ResultTimeout
event_classes.meaning: The deadline armed for the result of this operation is delivered to the core.

event_classes.name: Replay
event_classes.meaning: The same OperationId is presented to the store again.
